infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Comedy App to access your camera for capturing and sharing your moments. For example, you can take a photo to add to your post or start a live broadcast.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Comedy App to access your microphone during live streaming so your followers can hear you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Comedy App to access your photo library so you can share your experiences by uploading photos and videos to your posts, stories, and profile. For example, you can pick a photo from your library to share it.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Comedy App to use your location for maps, location tagging, and suggestions while you use the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow Comedy App to use your location while you are using the app for maps, tagging, and suggestions.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Comedy App uses your location only while you are using the app for maps and suggestions.
